README.md:
# CampusKart

CampusKart is a campus marketplace where students buy and sell second-hand items.

## Deployment

The app is deployed on Render (see render.yaml). Pushes to `main` redeploy automatically.

## Local setup

1. `npm install`
2. Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local`
3. `npm run dev`

PR #87 (merged): Move payments from card gateway to UPI deep links
Move payments from the card gateway to UPI deep links.

The card gateway needs merchant KYC, which we cannot get as a student club. UPI deep links work without a merchant account.

Tested on two Android phones. Removes the gateway call from checkout.
